scene: The dial clicks, sliding open bay doors onto three outward transit platforms.
picture: Flat side view. Along the stone depot floor, the player stands beside the unlocked chest. On the left waits a glass night funicular. In the centre sits a brass-plated bridge crawler. On the far right hangs an open window-cleaner gondola. Up high, neon transit signs glow across the three distinct exit bays.
